Deal and Pricing Overview

  • Merchant: Amazon

  • Currency: USD
  • Product/Variant: Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Desktop Charging Station

Device Specifications and Features

The charging station includes a total of eight ports designed to accommodate multiple devices simultaneously.

  • Port Configuration: Four USB Type-C ports and four USB Type-A ports
  • Power Output: Type-C ports deliver up to 100W each; Type-A ports deliver up to 18W each
  • Total Simultaneous Output: Capped at a maximum of 252W total output (126W max for USB-C and 126W max for USB-A)
  • Additional Features: Includes an integrated LCD status display to monitor real-time power draw per port
